Question ID: USH_U03_L03_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: SS.912.A.4.5, SS.912.A.4.6

Stimulus: WWI cause-mobilization organizer

Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task
This lesson explains why the United States entered World War I and how the federal government prepared the country for war. You will connect cause, mobilization, government power, and civil-liberties limits.German submarine warfare, economic ties to the Allies, the Zimmermann Telegram, and concern for international security pushed the United States toward war.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.4.5, SS.912.A.4.6.

Question: Which conclusion is best supported by the evidence detail? (World War I Causes, Mobilization, and War Measures)

generalfeedback.text: Use the stimulus, identify the evidence, explain the reasoning, and check the mapped standard before finalizing your answer.
